queries.help_seeking: TITLE_ABS:"mental health" AND ("help-seeking" OR "help seeking") AND (digital OR barriers)
queries.care_navigation: (depression OR "mental health") AND ("care navigation" OR "warm handoff" OR "stepped care")
queries.continuity: "mental health" AND ("measurement-based care" OR "continuity of care" OR "shared decision making")
queries.privacy: "mental health" AND (privacy OR consent) AND (digital OR app)
queries.indonesia: (Indonesia OR Indonesian) AND "mental health" AND (stigma OR access OR digital)
queries.language_equity: "mental health" AND "large language model" AND (language OR bias OR cultural)
queries.summarization: clinical AND summarization AND "large language model"
queries.safety: "mental health" AND (chatbot OR "large language model") AND (safety OR risk)

filters: FIRST_PDATE:[2021-10-27 TO 2026-10-26] AND HAS_ABSTRACT:Y AND SRC:MED
selection: purposive title/abstract screening; not exhaustive; newest-result bias
